sources.quote: COAT-ZN-YELLOW,Zinc 8 um with yellow chromate passivation,Zinc;CrVI
so a coating containing hexavalent chromium may not be used on our parts

findings.why: The proposed zinc with yellow chromate passivation contains hexavalent chromium. The Annex II exemption has expired and the ban continues under the replacing regulation, so it cannot be used on PN-050 in the EU market. The current coating, zinc flake, is Cr(VI)-free.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: PN-050 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Revision 4, which replaces revision 3, requires written Aurelia approval (PPAP) for a change of coating, plus 90 days' notice. No deviation or approval in force covers this change.
